_doc: Curated mod manifest for the 26.x server conversion. Every mod from Aged 3.1.2 (212 files) is classified: action = keep | rebuild | drop | client-optional. 'slug' is the Modrinth project used by resolve_deps.py. Reasons document WHY, so future maintainers can re-evaluate.
generated_from: Aged.mrpack v3.1.2 (MC 1.20.1) + Modrinth support scan on 2026-08-22

rebuild_groups.name: aged-survival
rebuild_groups.scope: Thirst (dirty-water risk), body temperature, food spoilage, vitamin/mineral diet. Server-authoritative, data-driven values mirroring upstream configs.

rebuild_groups.name: aged-skills
rebuild_groups.scope: Level/skill progression to 30 with attribute bonuses (health/movement/attack/defense/luck/stamina), job perks optional later, distance-based mob scaling.

rebuild_groups.name: aged-primitive
rebuild_groups.scope: Knapping/flint primitive start, beginner death penalty, recipe gating & ore-piece recipes via built-in datapack instead of separate mods.

rebuild_groups.name: aged-world
rebuild_groups.scope: Seasons-lite: crop growth modifiers, temperature offset per season; server-side with lightweight client HUD via vanilla bossbar/text alternatives.
